visual.title: Tangent and secant at x
visual.caption: Drag x or change h: the teal secant approaches the blue tangent, and the gap between their slopes shrinks toward zero.

predict.question: As h shrinks toward zero, what happens to the secant slope?
predict.explain: The secant is the average rate over h; as h goes to zero the average becomes the instantaneous rate, which is the derivative.
